condition: startOfDay computes midnight in the process's local timezone (UTC here), not in some other timezone the user has in mind; this is the intended behaviour.
workaround: If you need midnight in a different timezone, use timezone-aware helpers: date-fns-tz toZonedTime/fromZonedTime on v3, or TZDate / the `in` option from @date-fns/tz on v4. You can also set the process TZ.
